rows.status: Vetoed by the President on2012-02-28

committee_action.meethigh:
Original House Bill No. was 3507.  Approved by the Committee on June 7, 2011.

VETOED BY THE PRESIDENT ON FEBRUARY 28, 2011 STATING THE FOLLOWING REASONS:

WHILE THE INTENTION OF THE BILL IS LAUDABLE, ITS PROVISIONS RUN COUNTER TO THE RATIONALIZATION PROGRAM OF THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT IN STREAMLINING THE BUREAUCRACY.

I AM ALSO APPREHENSIVE OF THE OVERLAP AMONG CONCERNED AGENCIES WITH RESPECT TO THE JURISDICTIONAL AND INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS IN CARRYING OUT THE BILL'S OBJECTIVES, WHICH IS LIKELY TO CAUSE CONFUSION CONTRARY TO EFFECTIVE GOVERNANCE. 

THE BUDGETARY REQUIREMENTS OF THE BILL FAIL TO CONSIDER THE LIMITED BUDGET AND RESOURCES OF THE CONCERNED AGENCIES FOR THE EFFECTIVE AND SUSTAINED IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROVISIONS OF THE BILL.

FINALLY, THERE IS THE POSSIBILITY OF THE DISPLACEMENT OF THOUSANDS OF BARANGAY DAY CARE CENTER WORKERS WHO WILL NOT QUALIFY TO WORK AT CHILD DEVELOPMENT CENTERS UNDER THE NEW BILL.

IN VIEW THEREOF, I AM CONSTRAINED TO VETO THE ABOVE ENROLLED BILL.

VERY TRULY YOURS,
(SGD.) BENIGNO S. AQUINO III
